title: MiX: Micro-Inverted-Scaling for End-to-End Low-Bit Vision-Language Model Acceleration -- Artifact
description:
Artifact for the MICRO 2026 paper MiX: Micro-Inverted-Scaling for End-to-End Low-Bit Vision-Language Model Acceleration. A single repository with three self-contained parts:

  • accuracy/ — the MiX / MX / NVFP4 quantization code, per-benchmark YAML configs, and evaluation scripts reproducing the VLM and LLM accuracy tables (LLaVA-OneVision-7B, Qwen2-VL-7B, MiniCPM-V-2.6, Qwen2.5-VL 3B–72B; Llama-3.1-8B, Mistral-7B-v0.3, Qwen2.5-7B/14B).
  • hardware_rtl/ — SystemVerilog RTL, self-checking testbenches, and Synopsys Design Compiler / SAIF-power scripts for 15 systolic-array datapaths plus the MiX/MX quantizer and K-smoother, reproducing the 28 nm area and power results.
  • hardware_model/ — a standalone analytical energy/area simulator (NumPy + Matplotlib only) reproducing the iso-area speedup/energy and PE-efficiency Pareto figures.

Parts 1 and 3 use open-source Python; Part 2 requires Synopsys Design Compiler and VCS with a TSMC 28 nm standard-cell library. Model weights and datasets are pulled from HuggingFace on first run; no accuracy results are shipped.
